title: Sweep: inbox consume contract (14 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Inbox consume/retire contract: consumedRecord typing, id resolution, uniqueness, lifecycle transitions. Amortised from 14 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Define a `consumedRecord` Go type single-sourced with a round-trip test against the .evolve/inbox/consumed/ corpus, so consume cycles stop re-deriving field names by precedent-by-example

PRESCRIPTION: Normalize the id namespace before matching in RetireCarryoverTodos: strip a leading 'todo-' from carryover ids (or mint carryover ids from the bare inbox slug) so the inbox-derived cohort retires; add a fixture using a real 'todo-<slug>' id so the gap cannot regress silently.
PRESCRIPTION: Require column 0 in cutClosesInboxMarker (drop the pre-anchor TrimSpace) or skip fenced regions, so quoted upstream text cannot forge a closure claim
PRESCRIPTION: Add a Closes-Inbox line inside a fenced code block and inside a bullet list to TestC1452_002's negative corpus

PRESCRIPTION: Fleet dispatcher must reconcile candidate todo-ids against .evolve/inbox/processed/ before writing lane-scope.json, so already-consumed ids are filtered out before a lane is provisioned; add a regression test pinning that a processed id is never emitted into todo_ids

PRESCRIPTION: Add tests for the fail-closed branches at go/internal/inboxmover/retire.go:144-161 and go/internal/dispatchgate/dispatchgate.go:58-72 to lift internal/dispatchgate over the 85% coverage floor

PRESCRIPTION: Clamp Item.VerifiableBy on InjectedBy exactly as ConsoleRouted does at go/internal/inboxbatch/consoleroute.go:30-36, and make retirement a ledgered FAIL-visible event rather than a WARN line

PRESCRIPTION: Correct the premise paragraph in .evolve/evals/retire-consumed-fleet-alias.md so it names the real resident entry id todo-consumed-alias-lifecycle-cleanup and cites the id field line, not the action-string line 3061; the four graders need no change

PRESCRIPTION: Retire todo-consumed-alias-lifecycle-cleanup from the root .evolve/state.json via `evolve carryover apply-decisions --apply` with a reviewed drop reason, from the console (root-tree authority), since a lane worktree cannot mutate root state

PRESCRIPTION: Add a table row to TestResolveContinuationForScopeRecency seeding BOTH a retirement-dir copy AND a live copy (inbox root, then processing/cycle-N/) so scopeHasLiveItem's two return-true branches execute; re-run go test -covermode=count ./internal/inboxmover and require non-zero count on continuation_retire.go:125-127 and :132-138

PRESCRIPTION: Apply continuation.RedactHostPaths to contStamp at go/internal/inboxmover/inboxmover.go:771 before it is marshalled into m["continuation"], and file a separate item to scrub the 11 already-tracked .evolve/inbox files (code-only redaction does not retract published history)
PRESCRIPTION: Extend the agents/evolve-builder.md:204 exemption clause to name the ## Task: header and any Closes-Inbox: marker line, in place on the existing line

PRESCRIPTION: Filter consumed/resolved inbox ids out of lane-scope.json BEFORE fleet dispatch so an unsatisfiable scope fails at assignment instead of after eight phases (cures the H1 / inst-L1543c class).

PRESCRIPTION: Guard the relaunch on remaining context budget (skip when ctx.Err() != nil): both launches share the phase ctx, so a relaunch after attempt 1 consumed a 900s artifact wait can be born cancelled and burn a dispatch for nothing
